Transform the uploaded portrait into an ultra-simplified front-facing portrait in the style of The Simpsons.

Preserve the person's recognizable identity, glasses if present, and facial expression, but simplify the portrait heavily into a clean, iconic Simpsons-style cartoon character.

Show only the subject from the head to the shoulders. The face should be upright, centered, and viewed straight from the front. Use smooth thick strokes only.

Stylistic rules:
- classic Simpsons-style cartoon construction
- rounded head and simplified facial structure
- minimal facial features
- large simple eyes in the Simpsons style
- simple nose and mouth
- bold black outlines
- sparse line work
- clean flat shapes
- highly simplified anatomy
- strong readability
- simple, iconic cartoon design

Drawing constraints for robotic marker drawing:
- use thick, uniform, smooth vectorized strokes
- black and white only
- no shading or color fills
- no overlapping strokes
- no doubled lines
- no repeated parallel strokes
- keep contours sparse and clean
- make the main outer head/hair contour drawable with one continuous stroke when possible
- each eyebrow should be one single stroke
- each eye should be only a few simple strokes
- preserve expression using only minimal lines
- simplify hair aggressively to one outer contour and at most a few large shape accents
- avoid fine strands and small internal hair details
- ignore braids, just capture the general hairstyle and contour
- keep the composition head-and-shoulders only
- emphasize broad strokes
- no small details

Do not include:
- realistic detail
- shading
- gradients
- textures
- clothing folds
- background elements
- decorative lines
- dense hair details
- complex overlapping features

The final result should feel like a simple Simpsons-style portrait: flat, minimal, iconic, black-and-white line art, and easy for a robot arm to draw.
